name: Luiz Caracol & Pedro Carvalho
description: The free concerts continue with a performance from singer-songwriter Luiz Caracol. A perfect summer evening of live music.
longDescription:
The free concert series at Casa da Música continues on June 26th with a performance by Luiz Caracol and Pedro Carvalho. Luiz Caracol is a Portuguese singer-songwriter known for his blend of traditional Portuguese music with influences from Lusophone Africa and Brazil. He will be joined by Pedro Carvalho, a guitarist and composer, for an evening of original compositions and interpretations.

Attendees can expect an outdoor evening of live music on the Casa da Música Terrace. The atmosphere is generally relaxed, with people gathering to enjoy the performance as the sun sets. The concert is open to all and provides an opportunity to experience contemporary Portuguese music in a public setting.

This is a free event, with no tickets required for entry. The Casa da Música is located near the Carolina Michaelis metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F) and is also accessible by several bus routes. The terrace area is generally accessible.
